title: Bridge CLI ideabox writes to open cockpits
body: A CLI ideabox write does not refresh an open cockpit or mobile client. The REST API broadcasts ideaboxUpdated on /ws/vision (restored in COMP-PLAN-IDEA-UNIFY S3b-2), but the CLI writes records directly and the file watcher's fileChanged event goes out on a different socket (/ws/files) that neither ideabox client subscribes to. Bridging them is cross-server wiring: the docs watcher would need to recognise the ideabox path and reach the vision server's broadcast.
